quiet_night_spine_length_m.formula: length(ROAD-NS-SPINE projected to EPSG:4548; value refreshed after geometry repair)

night_protocol_state_count.formula: count(proposed, admitted, live, quiet, paused, handed_over)

floor_area_ratio.reason: Official control plan, verified buildings and official polygons are unavailable.

verified_night_noise_db.formula: field-measured LAeq by period and receptor
verified_night_noise_db.reason: No cleared site-level night-noise baseline is available.
verified_night_noise_db.measurement_plan: Measure LAeq by time band at verified residential and ecological receptors after site classification is confirmed.
verified_night_noise_db.decision_rule: Do not open the affected window without an accepted baseline and applicable limit; any verified exceedance pauses it.

verified_horizontal_illuminance_lux.formula: field-measured maintained illuminance by route segment
verified_horizontal_illuminance_lux.reason: No approved lighting survey or design standard selection is available.
verified_horizontal_illuminance_lux.responsible_role: Lighting professional with accessibility and community reviewers
verified_horizontal_illuminance_lux.measurement_plan: Measure maintained horizontal and vertical illuminance, uniformity and glare on each pilot segment.
verified_horizontal_illuminance_lux.decision_rule: Baseline safety lighting cannot be reduced; verified glare or failure of the selected standard pauses the pilot.

sleep_disturbance_complaint_rate.reason: No operation is authorised and no consented complaint baseline exists.
sleep_disturbance_complaint_rate.responsible_role: Independent record keeper and community reviewer
sleep_disturbance_complaint_rate.measurement_plan: Record verified disturbance cases attributable to each audited operating session, separated from general service complaints.
sleep_disturbance_complaint_rate.decision_rule: Any verified attributable disturbance triggers pause, investigation and restoration before reopening.

human_takeover_success_ratio.formula: successful staffed takeover drills / drills attempted
human_takeover_success_ratio.reason: Requires authorised drills and signed handover records.
human_takeover_success_ratio.measurement_plan: Run scenario-specific staffed takeover drills before opening and after any material revision.
human_takeover_success_ratio.decision_rule: All pre-opening drills must pass; target coverage is 1.0.

night_worker_paid_break_coverage_ratio.formula: eligible staffed shifts with verified paid break / eligible staffed shifts
night_worker_paid_break_coverage_ratio.reason: Operator, labour agreements and staffing plan are not confirmed.
night_worker_paid_break_coverage_ratio.measurement_plan: Audit eligible staffed shifts for paid rest, safe return and named relief coverage.
night_worker_paid_break_coverage_ratio.decision_rule: All eligible shifts must be covered; target coverage is 1.0 before extended operation.

light_gate_spine_intersection_count.decision_rule: All six conceptual cross-links must intersect the continuous spine before release.

scenario_readiness_field_coverage_ratio.formula: scenario nodes with yard, responsible role, stop condition, recovery evidence and non-AI fallback / 12
scenario_readiness_field_coverage_ratio.decision_rule: A scenario cannot enter live state when any readiness field is missing.

night_protocol_replay_check_count.formula: count of deterministic checks in the bundled tabletop replay; reproduce with: node visual/assets/run_night_protocol_tabletop.js --check

phase1_new_permanent_construction_area_s.formula: sum of declared new permanent construction in phase 1; PHASE-NS-01 sets new_permanent_construction=false, hence 0. A design commitment recomputable from the phasing layer, not an approval.
